WITH order_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(*) AS executed_order_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertune,
    executed_order_count,
    1.0 * executed_order_count / SUM(executed_order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM order_type_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT
    executed_order_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM type_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(executed_order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each matching execution row counts once toward its order type, so an order with multiple executions contributes multiple counts. Missing order types form one NULL group. Shares use only executions with a matching order.
